videos.title: Videos or playlists
videos.description: YouTube video URLs, 11-character video IDs, or playlist URLs (first 100 videos of a playlist). Short youtu.be and /shorts/ links work.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: Language code such as en, de, es. Falls back to the first available track (auto-generated tracks included).

includeSegments.title: Include timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: Add a segments array with start time and duration for each caption line.

chunkChars.title: RAG chunk size (characters)
chunkChars.description: If above 0, output a chunks array with text split at sentence boundaries to about this size, each with its start time and a deep link. Ready for vector databases. 0 disables.
